description: chatmcp verify exec, the exec wrapper for any external agent (plan task pod-26, docs/PROOF-CLI.md, "exec"): the claim window and its reading, the custom marker, the criteria step, the agent's process (closed input, process group, time limit, tree kill, the sweep after its root exits, Ctrl-C), the answer code, what is recorded, the refusals before the agent runs, the output adapters (lib/proof/adapters/index.mjs) and the grammar of exec, judged by tests/verify-proof-cli-exec.mjs.

mutations.name: EX-window-whole
mutations.what: a cut stream is read whole

mutations.name: EX-window-first-line
mutations.what: the line the window starts in is read too

mutations.name: EX-window-no-break
mutations.what: a cut stream without a line break is read as it is

mutations.name: EX-window-size
mutations.what: the claim window is 16 KiB

mutations.name: EX-log-size
mutations.what: a log keeps 8 MiB

mutations.name: EX-log-unbounded
mutations.what: the log keeps every byte (the guard above the cut is redundant: at the limit the cut is already empty, so the cut itself is what is broken)

mutations.name: EX-hash-skipped
mutations.what: the stream is not hashed

mutations.name: EX-bytes-uncounted

mutations.name: EX-truncated-flag

mutations.name: EX-custom-keeps-done

patches.old: if (!pattern) return { marker: contract.marker, reason: null, ...base };
patches.new: if (!pattern || contract.marker === 'DONE') return { marker: contract.marker, reason: null, ...base };

patches.new: const timer = setTimeout(() => { state.timedOut = true; }, timeoutMs);

mutations.name: EX-timeout-not-flagged

mutations.name: EX-kill-root-only
